title: Blue Sandstone
description: Just a texture pack to make the sandstone block blue
body:
# Blue Sandstone

This texture pack simply remplace all sandstone to **blue sandstone** for a better comparison between sand and sandstone

If you want to see how it's look like go in [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blue-sandstone/gallery) or below for the lazy ones
